question: What is the transverse tensile strength Yt of AS4/MTM45-1?

question: What is the transverse tensile strength Yt of AS4/MTM45-1?
answer: The transverse tensile strength Yt of AS4/MTM45-1 is 47.7 MPa (source: NCAMP NCP-RP-2008-004 Rev B, Table 3-3 p.35, RTD (75F) mean as-measured; verification status: verified_pdf). question: Which glass fibre material has the lowest Xc?
answer: The E-glass/LY556 material has a longitudinal compressive strength (Xc) of 570 MPa (source [1]: Soden, Hinton & Kaddour (1998) Compos Sci Technol 58:1011-1022 (WWFE-I)). Scotchply 1002 has a value of 610 MPa (source [2]: Tsai & Hahn (1980) Introduction to Composite Materials, Technomic; status: needs_check), and E-glass/MY750 has a value of 800 MPa (source [3]: Soden, Hinton & Kaddour (1998) Compos Sci Technol 58:1011-1022 (WWFE-I); status: needs_check). According to the ranking [R], E-glass/LY556 has the lowest Xc value.
